steps.title: Lesson 2: Core Concepts
steps.body: Key Fact: The age of criminal responsibility in England and Wales is 10 — one of the lowest in Europe. In Scotland it was raised to 12 in 2021 (from 8). Many argue it should be raised to 14. | Key Fact: Children aged 10-17 are dealt with in youth courts, not adult courts. Youth courts are less formal: no public gallery, judges don't wear wigs, parents must attend, and reporting restrictions protect the young person's identity. | Key Fact: Young offenders can receive: Referral Orders (first offence, attend a youth offender panel), Youth Rehabilitation Orders (community sentence with requirements), or Detention and Training Orders (custodial, from age 12). | Key Fact: ASSET assessments identify the needs of young offenders and the factors contributing to their offending behaviour — such as f
